Contract SearchBook::searchBookByBarCode(barcode: String): Set(Book) {
	definition:
		bookCopy: Set(BookCopy) = BookCopy.allInstance()->select(o|o.Barcode = barcode),
		books: Set(Book) = bookCopy->collect(o|o.BookBelongs)
	precondition:
		bookCopy.isEmpty() = false
	postcondition:
		books->forAll(o: Book|o.Status = CopyStatus.AVAILABLE) and
		result = books
}
